## Checklist

<!-- New languages aren't accepted for now, see CONTRIBUTING.md → "Pull requests". A fix to the
existing English or German text? Skip the "ran it" / "explain every line" items, tick the CLA box,
and confirm the strings render. -->

- [ ] I ran this and **watched it work**. I exercised the actual change, not just typecheck/tests.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run check:svelte-types` and `npm test` pass locally, or CI is green.
- [ ] I **understand and can explain every line**. If a reviewer asks about any change, I can answer it myself.
- [ ] I **tested it end to end on a running instance**, AI-assisted or not, no exceptions.
- [ ] I'll answer each finding of the AI code review that runs before merge (fix it, or explain why it doesn't apply).
- [ ] This PR is focused. If it is a feature, larger than a focused fix, or touches a complicated area (auth, playback, task system, migrations), the accepted discussion is linked above where needed **and I have hands-on software development experience** (larger changes are reviewed on that assumption, see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I agree to the project's [CLA](https://github.com/Sapd/lumastra/blob/main/.github/CLA.md) (the bot will prompt on your first PR).

## AI assistance (required disclosure)

<!-- Honest disclosure is a condition of acceptance, not a mark against you: the bar is the same
either way. Tick ONE extent and name the tools/models. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] **None**, written without AI tools.
- [ ] **Autocomplete / lookups only**, no generated logic.
- [ ] **Parts**, some logic or tests were generated, then reviewed and tested by me: <!-- say which parts -->
- [ ] **Most of it**, generated from my prompts, then reviewed, understood and tested by me.
